svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Prepare the ONE plywood backboard and THREE solid-timber support battens.
2. Check site anchor positions; the battens are NOT additional plywood panels.
3. Fix battens to suitable wall structure, then attach the single backboard panel.
4. No foam, fabric or second plywood substrate is part of this revision.
